games.title: Grow Rush 3D
games.tagline: Run through the right gates, grow into a giant, knock out the boss.
games.how: Drag left and right to steer. Blue gates grow you, red gates shrink you, crystals add +1. Dodge saws and walls, then out-size the boss at the finish.

games.title: Block Burst
games.tagline: Drag glossy blocks onto the board, clear lines, chain combos.
games.how: Drag a piece from the tray onto the 8×8 board. Fill a row or column to clear it; clear on consecutive moves for combos. The game ends when no piece fits.
rewarded: Second chance (clears the middle of the board)

games.title: Draw to Save
games.tagline: Draw one line to shield the dog from a bee swarm.
games.how: Draw a single line, then survive 5 seconds. Less ink = more stars.

games.title: Bolt Sort
games.tagline: Stack coloured nuts so every bolt holds one colour.
games.how: Tap a bolt to lift its top nuts, tap another to drop them on a matching colour.

games.title: Parking Jam Escape
games.tagline: Clear the jammed lot. Cars only drive forward.
games.how: Tap a car to drive it out. Three bumps and you're out.

games.title: Brain Trick
games.tagline: Riddles where the answer breaks the rules.
games.how: Tap, drag, and think sideways. Some answers hide in the question.

games.title: Mega Ramp Crash
games.tagline: Launch off a mega ramp and smash crate towers.
games.how: Hold to accelerate and boost. Spend coins on engine, fuel and ramp.

games.title: Ragdoll Tumble
games.tagline: Shove a ragdoll down a giant staircase for damage points.
games.how: Drag to aim, release to push. Bumpers and spikes score big.

games.title: Tiny Shop Tycoon
games.tagline: Grow a noodle cart into a street-food empire.
games.how: Tap to cook, upgrade stations, hire managers who earn while you're away.

games.title: Makeover Showdown
games.tagline: Style a look for the theme and beat your rival on the runway.
games.how: Pick hair, top, bottom, shoes and an extra that match the theme tags.

games.title: Planet Merge
games.tagline: Drop planets, merge matching ones, and build the Sun.
games.how: Aim and release to drop. Don't let the jar overflow the red line.

games.title: Highway Dodge
games.tagline: Weave through traffic with one thumb.
games.how: Tap left or right to switch lanes. Near misses build your combo.
